card.name: Words introducing an example or leading figure
card.fires_on: Words that set up a 'typical example of' or 'one of the foremost' statement, such as typical, outstanding, one of the, as the, a strong. The next word is likely to be representative or represent.

modes.label: Leading figure
modes.description: Words that start a claim that someone is a prominent or early example of a group.
modes.example: John Cage was<< one>> of the earliest artists who used radio technology

modes.label: Typical example
modes.description: Words that mark something as a typical or representative member of a class, often a drug class.
modes.example: Mifepristone significantly increased exposure of fluvastatin, a<< typical>> CYP2C8/2C

modes.label: Appositive naming a class member
modes.description: An article after a comma that introduces an example of a class.

card.writes: It pushes the model toward words like representative and represent.
card.plain: It fires on phrases that are about to say something is a typical or leading example of a group.
